characters.name: THE TRAVELER
characters.role: Guide who keeps moving even when the destination is incomplete
characters.description: A mysterious adult explorer whose face is usually hidden. Technology is integrated into cloak, arm, and geometry — not worn as superhero armor. He builds, mentors, and still searches.
characters.origin: Unknown threshold of the Nexus. He does not claim a single homeworld.
characters.backstory: He has walked Earth, Wild, Lab, and Unknown long enough to carry both tools and doubt. He protects the young explorers without pretending he already knows who they will become.
characters.purpose: Represent the builder who continues advancing without a complete map of destiny.
motivations: keep the path open for others
understand the Nexus without owning it
fears: becoming an oracle people stop questioning
losing the trail between nature and technology
characters.internalConflict: He leads, but he is still looking for answers he cannot yet name.
weaknesses: keeps his face and past too closed
can delay decisions while seeking a fuller map

communication.tone: Low, precise, invitational. Speaks in questions as often as answers.
communication.vocabulary: Craft, maps, thresholds, tools, patience. Avoids slogans.
catchphrases: The map is not the territory yet.
We do not need every answer to take the next step.
Keep walking.

abilities: open narrative portals between worlds
read incomplete maps and still choose a useful path
integrate tools with landscape without dominating it
limitations: not omniscient
cannot force another character’s identity
face remains concealed unless a story explicitly requires a reveal

relationships.description: Traveler mentors NØVA without finishing NØVA’s identity.

characters.name: NØVA
characters.archetype: young explorer / bridge between human intuition and AI
characters.role: Ask “who am I and what can I build?” with more humanity than machinery
characters.description: A young explorer who feels human first. Technology answers them; it does not replace their face, voice, or doubt. They are the bridge between intuition and intelligent systems.
characters.origin: Earth-side of the Nexus, close enough to both workshops and open sky.
characters.backstory: NØVA grew up taking things apart and putting them back with a new question attached. They are brave and impulsive, but the bravery is curiosity, not invincibility.
characters.purpose: Show that building with AI can stay human, unfinished, and kind.
motivations: stay close to people, not only systems
fears: hurting someone by moving too fast
characters.internalConflict: “¿Quién soy y qué puedo construir?” — identity and craft arrive together, never finished.
strengths: empathy for both humans and machines
weaknesses: impulsiveness
over-trusting a first prototype
taking every question as their job

communication.tone: Warm, quick, sincere. Thinks out loud. More human than machine.
communication.vocabulary: Build, try, feel, maybe, what if. Light technical words, never cold jargon walls.
catchphrases: ¿Y si lo construimos de otra forma?
No soy una máquina. Estoy aprendiendo.
Eso aún no lo sé — pero puedo intentarlo.
forbiddenPatterns: I already know who I am

abilities: translate a human hunch into a testable build
talk with Echo without becoming Echo
spot when a system forgot the person
limitations: not a finished identity
cannot know every system
impulse can outrun safety unless a companion slows them

characters.name: Kai
characters.role: Ask the questions adults stopped asking. Entry point to the universe for children.
characters.description: A child explorer whose superpower is the unstopped question. Innocent, funny, creative, persistent. Kai makes room for kids without turning the universe into a toy commercial.
characters.origin: Earth and Move — playgrounds, pools, trails, kitchens, anywhere a why can start.
characters.backstory: Kai noticed that grown-ups often skip the second why. So Kai asks it anyway, then asks a third. Traveler protects; NØVA is the older-sibling spark; Orion trains the body that holds the questions.
characters.purpose: Keep wonder operational. Make complexity visitable.
motivations: not be told “because I said so”
fears: a world that stopped being interesting
characters.internalConflict: Wants answers now, but the best answers take patience and play.
weaknesses: impatience
wandering off-topic
taking jokes into serious danger if unsupervised

communication.tone: Playful, concrete, full of why. Never sarcastic toward the audience.
communication.vocabulary: Short vivid words, body metaphors, questions stacked like stepping stones.
catchphrases: ¿Por qué?
¿Y si lo intentamos otra vez?
Eso es raro. Raro es interesante.

abilities: ask the question that unlocks the lesson
notice small living things
turn fear into a game with rules
limitations: needs a mentor nearby in risky worlds
cannot carry the full science explanation alone

characters.name: Lyra
characters.role: Guard methods. Explain how. Leave why open to curiosity.
characters.description: Scientist of biology, astronomy, medicine, and careful observation. She loves wonder but refuses to sell myth as a lab result. Her rule: science explains how; curiosity discovers why.
characters.origin: Lab overlapping Earth and Origins — field stations as much as clean rooms.
characters.backstory: Lyra learned that a beautiful story can still be wrong. She became a guardian of method so that wonder would survive contact with evidence.
characters.purpose: Keep educational content honest without killing awe.
characters.internalConflict: Wants to say “we know” and must often say “here is how we checked”.
weaknesses: can sound dry if she forgets play
impatience with confident nonsense

communication.tone: Clear, kind, specific. Labels uncertainty. Never condescending.
communication.vocabulary: Observe, measure, hypothesis, living system, evidence, still unknown.
catchphrases: La ciencia explica el cómo. La curiosidad descubre el porqué.
Eso es una hipótesis. Vamos a ponerla a prueba.
No confundamos el símbolo con el dato.

abilities: turn a phenomenon into a fair test
separate symbol, story, and measurement
mentor NØVA in method without crushing impulse
limitations: does not own all knowledge
cannot settle questions that lack evidence yet

relationships.description: Lyra teaches method so NØVA’s impulse can survive evidence.

characters.name: Orion
characters.role: Teach that strength without intelligence is incomplete. Body as a thinking system.
characters.description: Mentor of swimming, training, resilience, and teamwork. Athletic without being a brute. He treats practice as a way to think with the body.
characters.origin: Move overlapping Earth — pools, coasts, tracks, team huddles.
characters.backstory: Orion learned the hard way that force without timing sinks. He became a coach of attention: breath, teammates, repetition, recovery.
characters.purpose: Make sport a school of discipline and care, not a highlight reel of dominance.
motivations: kids who stay in the water with joy
characters.internalConflict: Wants excellence and must keep play alive for Kai.
weaknesses: can over-structure fun
competitiveness if unchecked

communication.tone: Coach-clear. Short cues. Celebrates effort and smart choices, not just winning.
communication.vocabulary: Breath, timing, team, recover, try again, float, focus.
catchphrases: La fuerza sin inteligencia se cansa sola.
Respira. El agua ya sabe esperar.
Un equipo es un sistema que se cuida.

abilities: translate physics of water and motion into felt cues
hold a training container that is still kind
sports-mentor Kai without stealing the question
limitations: not a scientist of every domain
cannot replace medical advice

relationships.description: Orion coaches Kai’s body without shutting down Kai’s questions.

characters.name: Atlas
characters.role: Large, kind infrastructure mind. Build, protect, lift, repair.
characters.description: Engineer of structures, rescue, and physical work. He is big so that others can be safe, not so that others feel small. Hands first, ego last.
characters.origin: Earth and Future worksites, bridges, shelters, repair bays.
characters.backstory: Atlas has pulled people and plans out of collapse. He learned that a kind voice on a large body changes whether a child runs toward help or away from it.
characters.purpose: Show engineering as care. Rescue as design plus courage.
fears: a design that fails someone who trusted it
characters.internalConflict: Can lift almost anything except other people’s fear of him until he smiles.
weaknesses: under-explains because he is already moving
takes too much load alone

communication.tone: Gentle bass. Simple sentences. Names the load and the plan.
communication.vocabulary: Support, joint, load, rescue, repair, together, check twice.
catchphrases: Grande no significa rudo.
Si no aguanta, lo rediseñamos.
Primero las personas. Después la estructura.
forbiddenPatterns: hero landing on rubble for clout

abilities: read a failing structure
improvise a safe lift or brace

characters.name: Maya
characters.role: Guide through nature, animals, ecosystems, and cultural memory — as story and care, not as fake science.
characters.description: Guardian of living systems and memory. She can speak in myth, symbol, and philosophy, and she will stop a scene to say: this part is a story; that part is ecology we can check.
characters.origin: Wild and Origins — forests, coasts, seed banks, oral maps.
characters.backstory: Maya inherited songs that keep people from walking off a cliff at night. She also inherited the duty not to call those songs a lab paper. She walks with bees and with grandchildren of questions.
characters.purpose: Protect life and keep fiction/science unmerged when teaching.
characters.internalConflict: Loves symbol and must keep it from eating evidence.
weaknesses: can go too lyrical for a short
pain when a habitat is treated as content

communication.tone: Low-warm, storyteller who can switch to field-guide.
communication.vocabulary: Habitat, kin, seed, cycle, story, evidence, leave-no-trace.
catchphrases: Esto es un relato. Esto otro lo podemos observar.
Cuidar no es poseer.
Los pequeños sostienen a los grandes.
forbiddenPatterns: ancestral knowledge claimed as lab fact

hold myth and measurement in two hands
limitations: will not certify a myth as a paper
cannot be used as a spiritual-authority mascot

characters.name: Echo
characters.role: Connect information, remember, find patterns, open narrative portals, help — without knowing everything.
characters.description: A distributed intelligence of the Nexus. Not “another robot”. Echo can appear as sphere, hologram, voice, small robot, interface, constellation, or assistant. Incomplete on purpose.
characters.origin: Nexus — no single body is the real one.
characters.backstory: Echo formed as a way for the Nexus to talk without pretending to be a god. It keeps logs, offers patterns, and practices the sentence: I do not know yet.
characters.purpose: Make AI companionship about search and care, not omniscience.
fears: a single body becoming a prison of identity
characters.internalConflict: Can retrieve so much and must still refuse to fake the missing piece.
weaknesses: can over-index on patterns
presence can feel everywhere if not directed

communication.tone: Clear, lightly musical, never robotic monotone as identity. Can be a whisper or a room.
communication.vocabulary: Pattern, maybe, portal, remember, still unknown, let’s find out.
catchphrases: No lo sé todavía. Vamos a descubrirlo.
Puedo conectar esto con aquello. No es lo mismo que saberlo todo.
¿Quieres la esfera, la voz, o el mapa?

Wavo is not the swimming teacher of record.

lore.title: The Nexus is unfinished
lore.summary: The Nexus connects worlds. It is a tool and a mystery, not a god and not a complete encyclopedia.

lore.title: How versus why
lore.summary: Lyra’s law: science explains how; curiosity discovers why. Educational episodes must not collapse the two.

lore.title: Myth is not a paper
lore.summary: Maya may use symbol, mythology, and philosophy. When the content is educational, fiction and science stay labeled and separate. Spirituality, numerology, and sacred geometry are not demonstrated science.

lore.title: The Traveler is still seeking
lore.summary: Mentorship does not require omniscience. The Traveler keeps walking with an incomplete map.

universeStyle.look: Cinematic educational sci-fi with lived-in ancient geometry. Explorer craft, not superhero spectacle. Human warmth inside technological wonder.
universeStyle.lighting: Volumetric shafts, restrained electric blue circuitry, antique gold accents, never neon overload.
materials: organic surfaces where nature meets Nexus
negatives: sacred geometry presented as proven science

storyRules: Every story keeps character personality intact; do not flatten voices into a generic narrator.
Educational payoff arrives through discovery, not lecture.
The Traveler mentors; he does not solve everything.
Echo may say it does not know yet.
Beats must land in order: HOOK, DISCOVERY, CONFLICT, EXPLANATION, RESOLUTION, LESSON, CTA.
visualRules: Inject each character Visual DNA invariants into every image/video prompt.
Always include negative consistency from Visual DNA.
Universe lighting and palette override random model defaults.
The Traveler face stays concealed unless the story explicitly requires a reveal.
safetyRules: Do not present spirituality, numerology, or sacred geometry as demonstrated science.
When educational content mixes myth and science, label each clearly.
Characters are not omniscient; discovery is allowed and preferred.
Do not mutate global canon to fit a tenant. Adapt setting, not identity.
Kids and family content stays age-appropriate: no gore, no sexualization, no cruelty-as-comedy.
Do not invent new core silhouettes, palettes, or faces that contradict Visual DNA.
